Exact integer Laurent calculation yields M4=28+8 cos(phi), M6=256+144 cos(phi) for m>=4, and M6=256+144 cos(phi)+6(3+2cos(phi))cos(psi) for m=3. The exact nonnegative deficit identities prove both sharp bounds and all equality phases; continuity proves whole intervals. A standalone integer-Laurent verifier reproduced formulas for 3<=m<=44 and explicit equality examples; the infinite result rests on the alias argument.
